gloss: whether one likes it or not; willy-nilly

definitions.gloss: whether one likes it or not; willy-nilly; without choice
definitions.explanation: Describes a situation where something happens regardless of one's wishes or consent. The person affected has no say in the matter.

examples.japanese: {否応|いやおう}なし⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{参加|さんか}→参加：02498_sanka⟧⟦させられた→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: I was made to participate whether I liked it or not.

examples.japanese: ⟦{時代|じだい}→時代：01424_jidai⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{流|なが}れ→流れ：03504_nagare⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{否応|いやおう}なし⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{人|ひと}→人：00476_hito⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{変|か}える→変える：01089_kaeru⟧。
examples.english: The flow of the times changes people whether they like it or not.

examples.japanese: ⟦グローバル{化|か}→グローバル化：30240_guroobaruka⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{否応|いやおう}なし⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{進|すす}んで→進む：01225_susumu⟧いく。

notes:
A literary and somewhat formal expression. Composed of ⟦{否|いや}→否：01920_iya⟧ (no, unwilling) and {応|おう} (yes, willing), it literally means "without yes or no" — that is, without being given the choice. Most commonly used with ⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧ as an adverb: {否応|いやおう}なし⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧.

FORMS:
- ⟦{否応|いやおう}なく→否応なく：06686_iyaounaku⟧: same meaning, slightly more common in modern usage
- {否応|いやおう}なし⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧: the most standard adverbial form

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {否応|いやおう}なし⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{巻|ま}き{込|こ}まれる→巻き込む：05753_makikomu⟧: to get dragged in regardless
- {否応|いやおう}なし⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{変|か}わる→変わる：00714_kawaru⟧: to change whether one likes it or not
- {否応|いやおう}なし⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{従|したが}う→従う：02059_shitagau⟧: to comply without choice

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{有無|うむ}→有無：13019_umu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{言|い}わさず: without letting someone object — stronger, more forceful
- ⟦{強制的|きょうせいてき}→強制的：06133_kyouseiteki⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧: compulsorily — more formal and administrative
- しょう⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦なく→ない：01118_nai⟧: reluctantly — focuses on the person's resignation rather than the external force
